title: Project Engineer
description:
Position Overview 
 We are seeking highly motivated fresh graduates or professionals with up to 1 year of experience to join our PDS team in Mumbai as Project Engineers. This exceptional learning opportunities in construction project management, providing exposure to high-profile commercial real estate projects for leading multinational clients. You will work alongside experienced project managers and engineers while developing technical and professional competencies essential for a successful career in project management. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Project Delivery Support: You will support the PDS team in delivering construction and fit-out projects across various asset classes. This includes assisting project engineers and managers with day-to-day project coordination, tracking project milestones, and ensuring deliverables are completed according to established timelines. You will gain comprehensive exposure to JLLs project delivery methodologies and governance frameworks. Site Supervision Quality Monitoring: Regular site visits to active construction sites will form a critical part of your learning experience. You will accompany senior team members to commercial office developments, corporate fit-out projects, and other facilities to observe construction activities, understand site management practices, and learn quality control procedures. Responsibilities include documenting site conditions through photographs, noting work progress, identifying quality issues, and assisting in punch list preparation. Technical Documentation Drawing Management: You will assist in reviewing and managing technical documentation including architectural drawings, MEP layouts, structural plans, and specifications. This involves coordinating drawing revisions, maintaining updated drawing registers, tracking submittal logs, and ensuring document version control. You will learn to identify potential clashes or coordination issues across different engineering disciplines. Meeting Coordination Reporting: Supporting the preparation and distribution of meeting agendas, attending project meetings, recording minutes, and tracking action items will develop your project coordination skills. You will help prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, project presentations, and status dashboards for internal teams and client stakeholders. Contractor Vendor Coordination: You will assist in coordinating with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and material suppliers. This includes tracking contractor deliverables, obtaining competitive quotations, maintaining vendor databases, processing material submittals and approvals, and supporting the procurement process under guidance from senior team members. Budget Schedule Tracking: Learning to monitor project budgets and schedules is essential. You will assist in tracking costs against approved budgets, reviewing contractor payment applications, maintaining cost registers, and helping prepare budget variance reports. For schedule management, you will support updating project schedules, tracking critical path activities, and identifying potential delays. Health, Safety Environment (HSE): Understanding and promoting safety culture is paramount. You will participate in site safety inductions, attend safety meetings, assist in conducting safety inspections, and ensure compliance with JLLs HSE policies. You will learn to identify potential hazards and understand corrective action protocols. Client Interaction Relationship Management: Under supervision, you will gain exposure to client interactions, learning professional communication standards and relationship management practices. This includes attending client meetings, understanding client requirements, and delivering service excellence aligned with JLL PDS standards. Continuous Learning Professional Development: Active participation in JLLs training programs, technical workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions is expected. You will have opportunities to learn industry best practices, emerging technologies in construction, and project management tools and techniques. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education: Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline from a recognized institution. Recent graduates or professionals with up to 1 year of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. Technical Knowledge: Basic understanding of construction processes, building systems, and engineering principles Familiarity with reading technical drawings and engineering specifications Basic proficiency in AutoCAD (ability to view and understand drawings) Competency in MS Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint Willingness to learn project management software such as MS Project, Primavera, or similar tools Core Competencies: Strong desire to learn and grow within the project management profession Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi (verbal and written) Detail-oriented with good organizational and time management abilities Ability to work collaboratively in team environments Proactive attitude with problem-solving mindset Adaptability and willingness to take on diverse responsibilities Professional demeanor suitable for client-facing interactions Other Requirements: Willingness to conduct frequent site visits across Mumbai and surrounding areas (MMR region) Flexibility to work on-site as required by project demands Ability to work occasionally beyond standard hours to meet project deadlines 
 
 Location 
 Mumbai, MH Scheduled Weekly Hours: 48

description:
Company Description 
 Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. 

 Job Description 
 We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Mechanical Engineer to join our organization in Mumbai, India, specializing in data center projects. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing mechanical systems that support critical data center infrastructure. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient operations, regulatory compliance, and superior performance of mechanical systems in demanding data center environments. Design and develop mechanical systems for data center cooling, power distribution, and infrastructure using CAD software and industry-standard tools Analyze thermal management requirements and create solutions to optimize cooling efficiency and energy consumption Conduct detailed engineering calculations and simulations to ensure mechanical systems meet performance specifications and safety standards Oversee equipment installation, commissioning, and testing to verify system functionality and compliance with design specifications Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, including design drawings, specifications, and operational manuals Collaborate with project managers, contractors, and vendors to ensure timely project delivery and adherence to budgets Identify and resolve mechanical system issues through systematic troubleshooting and root cause analysis Monitor and evaluate mechanical system performance, recommending improvements for efficiency and reliability Ensure all mechanical installations comply with relevant industry standards, building codes, and data center best practices Participate in project planning and feasibility studies for new data center initiatives 

 Qualifications 
 Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, or equivalent) for mechanical design and modeling Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, cooling technologies, and thermal management principles specific to data centers Experience with mechanical equipment selection, sizing, and specification Experience with Building Information Modeling (BIM) and energy efficiency optimization (preferred) Familiarity with vendor management and equipment procurement processes (preferred) ASHRAE certification or equivalent mechanical engineering credentials (preferred) Ability to work effectively in team environments and communicate complex technical information clearly 

 Additional Information 
 Solid understanding of data center infrastructure standards and best practices Demonstrated project management experience with ability to coordinate multiple workstreams Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail Strong technical writing and documentation capabilities Knowledge of building codes, safety regulations, and compliance requirements for data center facilities At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. title: Senior Executive - International Sales
description:
Senior Executive - International Sales Company: ALAN Electronic Systems Private Limited Department: International Sales Location: Head Office, Ambernath, Maharashtra (international travel required) Reporting To: Head of Department - International Sales Experience: 8-12 years Role Overview The Senior Executive - International Sales owns the execution quality of ALANs international sales administration: order processing, export documentation, dispatch, payment collection and partner support. The role leads the Executive and Junior Executive who perform these tasks and is accountable for every activity being completed within the defined timelines. The role also resolves technical issues raised by sales partners on ALAN products, prepares AOP data and presentations, plans and executes the Annual Sales & Service Partners Meeting (ASPM), and represents ALAN at international exhibitions and conferences. Key Responsibilities 1. Order Processing Oversight Ensure partner POs are received, verified against the approved price list, discounts, payment terms, and booked in ERP within the defined TAT Review and approve proforma invoices and order confirmations before release to the partner Ensure country-specific requirements are checked before booking: product registration, CE certificate validity, import permits and labelling Review partner credit status and outstanding dues on each order; take exceptions to the HoD for approval Review the order register daily for pending, delayed and incorrectly booked orders 2. Fulfilment and Dispatch Monitoring Monitor order status against committed dates; coordinate with planning, production, stores and QC to remove delays Ensure partners receive revised dates before the due date when delays occur Approve order changes, partial shipments and cancellations; ensure approvals are documented Ensure demo unit, spare parts and sample dispatches follow approved requests 3. Export Documentation and Logistics Review export documents before dispatch: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, CE certificate, conformity documents and partner-specific documents Approve freight forwarder and courier selection based on quotes, transit time and reliability Ensure dispatch intimation and tracking details reach the partner on dispatch day Resolve transit delays, damage and customs queries with the forwarder and partner Ensure statutory export records are complete: shipping bill, bank realization certificate, export incentive and duty claims 4. Payment and Receivables Control Ensure payments are tracked against agreed terms: advance and credit Review partner-wise receivables ageing weekly and report to the HoD Follow up personally on overdue accounts and recommend order hold where required Ensure invoices are closed after confirmed receipt and bank documents are filed 5. Technical Support to Sales Partners Resolve partner and end-user queries on ALAN electrosurgical generators and accessories: setup, operation, settings, compatibility and performance Diagnose reported faults and complaints with the partner, using photographs, videos and error details; guide corrective steps remotely Coordinate with service, QA and D&D when the issue needs repair, replacement or design review Ensure complaints, returns and replacements are logged, investigated and closed with recorded corrective action Identify repeat issues by product and partner; report patterns to QA and the HoD Support partner demos, product training and technical clarifications for tenders and registrations Maintain product technical documents, FAQs and troubleshooting guides for partner use 6. Partner Records and Compliance Ensure partner master data is current: agreements, validity, territory, price lists, registration documents and contacts Track expiry of agreements, product registrations and certificates; initiate renewals in advance Ensure authorization letters, declarations and tender documents requested by partners are issued on time 7. Exhibitions, Conferences and ASPM Represent ALAN at international exhibitions and conferences: booth operation, product presentation and partner meetings Plan events end to end: selection, registration, exhibit shipment and customs, travel, collaterals and budget Capture leads in a standard format; share the lead list and event report and track follow-up to closure Report event cost against leads generated and orders closed Plan and execute the Annual Sales & Service Partners Meeting (ASPM): venue and date finalisation, partner invitations and confirmations, agenda and speaker schedule, presentations, travel and logistics, budget and on-ground execution Set the ASPM timeline with owners and deadlines; track progress weekly and ensure every milestone is met on time Prepare the ASPM report with action points and track follow-up to closure 8.
